name: Dungeon Days
source:
Wes Cragvern, the Assistant Janitor of the world's greatest dungeon, is tasked with spying on a group of new adventurers that are a potential threat to his home. 

Along with his childhood friend, a White Dragon woman named Pah'Sharah, they set out to the nearby town of Springdale to find out what's the deal with these new adventurers. Little do they know about how complicated their lives were about to become from this simple mission.

Events they could never have foreseen pile on top of one another that lead them all towards an uncertain future! If Wes is going to save the ones he cares for, he's going to have to step up from wielding a mop to wielding the power of a Dungeon Lord!

[From [URL=https://dungeon-days.itch.io/dungeon-days]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
韦斯·克拉格文是世界上最伟大的地下城的助理看门人，他的任务是监视一群对他的家园构成潜在威胁的新冒险家。

他们和他儿时的朋友，一位名叫帕莎拉的白龙女子一起，出发前往附近的斯普林代尔小镇，了解这些新冒险家的情况。他们几乎不知道这个简单的任务将让他们的生活变得多么复杂。

他们永远无法预见的事件接二连三地发生，导致他们所有人走向不确定的未来！如果韦斯想要拯救他所关心的人，他就必须从使用拖把升级为使用地下城领主的力量！

[来自 [URL=https://dungeon-days.itch.io/dungeon-days]itch.io[/URL]]
